features.name: Ear for Deceit
features.desc: When you make a Wisdom (Insight) check to detect a lie, you can treat a d20 roll of 7 or lower as an 8.

features.name: Eye for Detail
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, you make a Wisdom (Perception) check (to spot a hidden creature or object) or an Intelligence (Investigation) check (to find clues).

features.name: Insightful Fighting
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, you make a Wisdom (Insight) check contested by the target's Charisma (Deception); on a success, you can apply Sneak Attack against it without Advantage (for 1 minute or until you choose a new target).

features.name: Steady Eye
features.desc: You have Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Intelligence (Investigation) checks if you have moved no more than half your Speed this turn.

features.name: Unerring Eye
features.desc: As an action, you sense illusions, shapechangers, and magic that deceives the senses within 30 feet. Number of uses equals your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1), regained on a Long Rest.

features.name: Eye for Weakness
features.desc: While Insightful Fighting is in effect against a creature, your Sneak Attack damage against it increases by 3d6.
